Name: Aviary Retexture for Hootin' and Hollerin'
Author: cajcbell
Description:
[size=4][i]This mod replaces the building texture from 7thAxis's owl mod - it does nothing on its own![/i][/size]

[size=4][b]This is a simple retexture of the aviary for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43539]Hootin' & Hollerin'[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/7thAxis?gameId=1303]7thAxis[/url].[/b][/size]
[size=4]I really adore this mod, including the building, but the swamp-witch vibe clashes with the old countryside pomp of my current save. [/size]


[size=4][b]Thank you to 7th Axis for the permission to make this! I had a lot of fun figuring it out. [/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This aviary was made to match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44109?tab=posts]Quaint Living - Buildings[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/PlatinumCats?gameId=1303]PlatinumCats[/url].  Assets from PlatinumCats' [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36102]Cherry Lake Tilesheets[/url] were used in this mod. Therefore, it is listed as a dependency. [/b][/size]

[size=5]Installation:[/size]
[size=4]- Install [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43539]Hootin' & Hollerin'[/url][/b] [b]FIRST[/b][/size]
[size=4]- Download this mod and [b]unzip it to your Mods folder[/b][/size]
[size=4]- [b]Replace All [/b]when prompted (if you were not asked to Replace All, you did not install correctly!)[/size]

[size=4]This has not been tested with recolors, but feel free to make recolor versions as needed. Just make sure to credit back to 7thAxis and the original mod![/size]

I made this for fun for my current save. :)
